purpose: kulaputraśikṣārthanimittena likhitam: written for the instruction of a kulaputra (son of good family), unnamed
notes: The colophon names no person. The anonymous scribe speaks in the first person (likhāmy ahaṃ) and states the copy was made for the instruction of a kulaputra, who is not named. 'pūrvvādṛṣṭa drasa〈〈na〉〉na' appears corrupt, perhaps for pūrvādṛṣṭadarśana(?) or yādṛśaṃ pustakaṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛśaṃ likhitaṃ mayā; no name can be read from it. No date, place, or king is given.
